_readme: Third read of Mt. San Antonio College's maps (S345, SkyLantern). Reads 1 and 2 (runs 37799874023, 37800558615) found no suggested order on the catalog's program pages or its Degrees and Certificates page, though the Schedule of Classes says the Catalog shows one. A web search (2026-10-08) found the college's Guided Pathways program list (www.mtsac.edu/guided-pathways/), where each program opens a pathway through a 'View Course Sequence' button and some carry a '1st Semester Plan'. This read loads that list and follows the pilot programs' entries (Fire Technology, Nursing, Early Childhood Education).

questions.map_source: Where the college publishes a program's term-by-term map, and in what form (a page, a PDF, an interactive tool).
questions.map_shape: How one map names its terms and lists its courses, read on one map the index links.
